adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new shared refresh helpers (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` and `parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) and updates several integrations (e.g., Hubspot `lib/CalendarService.ts`, Google/Office365 calendar services, Office365 video, Webex) to call them instead of their prior direct refresh logic. These helpers introduce nontrivial conditional behavior (switching to `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, relaxing token schema via `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, and even forcing a `refresh_token` value when missing). The PR does not add any tests in the diff to validate that each integration’s refresh flow still matches prior behavior (e.g., refresh_token retention/merging). The finding’s claim that there are *no existing* unit tests in the repo for these integrations can’t be verified from the diff alone, but the “no new verification for changed behavior” concern is diff-grounded.
